note: Saint Kitts and Nevis, read on the Government's own portal (gov.kn, 'In SKN Work Visa Procurement: How To Procure a Work Permit') on 2026-10-30. The work visa is for people coming to Saint Kitts and Nevis to work; typically the employer there helps with the process, there is a waiting period, and after acceptance the federation's consulate gives the visa; the steps are to get a job, gather the documents and submit them to the federation's embassies and consulates abroad (the Embassy in Washington and the Consulate General in New York are named), so it is read as asked from abroad (abroad). The page states no fee, time, term, renewal or what work the visa allows (the work permit under the labour law is the work engine's), and its sample document list sits on a non-government site, not read. Free movement within the OECS (Saint Kitts and Nevis is a member) and permanent residence aren't on this page and aren't written.

sources.title: The Government of St. Kitts and Nevis, In SKN Work Visa Procurement
sources.said: How To Procure a Work Permit ... This visa is for people interested in coming to St. Kitts & Nevis to work. Typically, your employer in St. Kitts & Nevis will help you out with this process. ... A waiting period is required.  However, after acceptance, the St. Kitts & Nevis Consulate will give to you your brand new St. Kitts & Nevis visa. ... If you’re outside of the U.S.: ... Embassy of St. Kitts and Nevis to the United States of America ... Consulate General of St. Kitts and Nevis, New York
